newsitem.title: USA: Northrop plans lay offs, relocations - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Northrop plans lay offs, relocations - NYT.

text.p: Northrop Grumman Corp announced plans to lay off or relocate 445 workers at its former headquarters in Bethpage, New York, the New York Times reported on Friday.

The company, now based in Los Angeles, employed 25,000 people on Long Island in the mid 1980s, the newspaper said. It currently employs 2,700 people in New York's Nassau and Suffolk counties, the paper said.

Northrop said its military aircraft systems division, which conducted support services and engineering work on military planes, would be moved to other company centers in Florida and Maryland, the newspaper said.
Of the unit's 420 workers, 80 contract workers would lose their jobs and 340 full-time employees would either move or lose their jobs, the newspaper said.
Another 25 jobs in other operations at Bethpage would move to Florida, the Times said.
The company was not immediately available to comment.
